node.statement: G3 PROFILE CONVERSION IDENTITY. For n=MN and A=hM+b with 0<=b<M and h<N, the number raw_M(A) of size-A supports whose points outside their full M-fibers form a tail of size <M is C(N,h)[x^b]H_M(x)^(N-h), where H_M(x)=sum_{j=0}^{M-1}C(M,j)x^j. Since Q_M(A)=C(N-1,h), this equals Q_M(A)*N/(N-h)*[x^b]H_M(x)^(N-h). Thus the canonical-class weight is one and the exact conversion to the fixed-tail quotient profile has no undeclared multiplicity.
